Simple mandalas with the center left open for a name, a quote or a date. Made for wall tags, signs, cards, ornaments and name stickers. Type your words, or download the frame alone and letter it yourself.

    How to make a mandala frame

    1. Pick a frame. Choose one of the starting designs, or press Surprise me for a new one.
    2. Type your words. Under Make it yours, type up to two lines and pick serif or sans serif lettering. The words are sized to fit the opening.
    3. Size the opening. Slide Opening to make more room or less. The maker shows the opening as a share of the design's width, and how wide it prints on a page and on a sticker.
    4. Download. A PNG to print, or a line drawing SVG for your design software. A PDF, a sticker, or a cut-ready SVG or DXF are under Other formats.

    For wall tags, signs and screen printing

    Small pieces need bold lines. These frames use a line weight of 4.5 to 6, which prints about 0.3 mm wide on a design 2 inches across: enough for screen printing and laser engraving. Going smaller, or printing with a coarse screen? Raise Line weight under Make it yours.

    To set the words in your own lettering, untick Put the words in downloads under Get your design, then download a Line drawing SVG at the size you need. It has a transparent background and an empty center, so you can place it on your tag or sign and add the words in your own software. The words stay in the maker as a preview.

    For a cut frame in vinyl, paper, wood or metal, switch Making to Cut file. Cut files always leave the center open.

    Name stickers

    A frame with a name makes a good round sticker or party favor. Switch Making to Sticker to choose the size and the look, or see the mandala sticker maker.

    Questions

    Can I put a quote in the middle?

    Yes, up to two lines of 30 characters each, sized to fit the opening. For a longer quote, untick Put the words in downloads under Get your design, download the frame, and set the quote in your own design software.

    How do I make a monogram?

    Type a single capital letter as the words. The laurel wreath and petal frames suit a monogram, with the serif lettering.

    Can I use my own font?

    The maker letters in serif or sans serif. For any other font, untick Put the words in downloads and add your lettering in your design or cutting software. The words stay in the maker as a preview.

    Can I sell what I make with these frames?

    Yes. The frames and everything you make with them are free to use, including on wall tags, signs, cards and stickers you sell.

    Will the frame cut on a Cricut or a laser?

    Yes. Download a cut-ready SVG or a DXF. Cut files always leave the center open, so the words don't cut out as loose letters, and the maker tells you if any shape would come out as a separate piece.
